items.title: The Lazy Bicycle
items.text:
Title: The Lazy Bicycle
Setting: street
Dad: Why did the bicycle fall over?
Kid: I do not know. Why?
Dad: Because it was two tired! [rimshot]
Kid: Dad, that was wheely bad.
